title: Ra crew in New World but without papyrus raft
version: 22 July 1969 Bridgetown dateline, reprinted 28 July 1969, second section front, PDF page 9

passages.locator: PDF p. 9, article headline and first two columns
passages.note: Ra sailed from Safi on 25 May; the crew arrived in Shenandoah without Ra. Heyerdahl describes the enterprise as a scientific experiment and says the crew decided to abandon ship.

passages.note: The raft was left pointed toward Barbados; its subsequent fate was then uncertain.
